newsitem.title: USA: Integrated Process gets $13.5 mln orders.
newsitem.headline: Integrated Process gets $13.5 mln orders.

text.p: Integrated Process Equipment Corp said on Thursday the company recently received multiple orders totaling more than $13.5 million from major customers in the United States, Europe and Asia for its planarization systems used in the manufacture of semiconductors.
It said the orders were received from Dynamic Random Access Memory and microprocessor manufacturers.
The equipment will be used for both metal and oxide planarization applications, the company said.
